description: GraphRAG global sensemaking (agent-driven, no LLM in the server). Detects communities (densely-connected entity clusters) over the entity graph on demand via weighted label propagation, and returns each community's top entities + linked memories. This is the corpus-level view that chunk-level search can't give — synthesize named themes from the communities to answer "what are the main themes?".

limit.description: Maximum communities to return, largest first (default 20)

min_size.description: Drop communities with fewer than this many entities (default 1)

name: memory_communities
